Companion service

Managed documentation hosting

The companion AOSDF Hosting application connects GitHub repositories to documentation builds and deployment, with project ownership and editor/viewer sharing.

The hosted application has its own login, dashboard and deployment configuration. This public website is independently buildable and does not include that service or assume a particular operator URL.

You can use AOSDF and build project documentation locally without a hosting account. Follow the repository setup guide to get started.
